reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: Under RA 9514 Section 10.2.5.2(B), what fire-resistance rating is required for a protected exit that connects three storeys or less?
proposed.rationale: RA 9514 distinguishes protected exits connecting three storeys or less from those connecting four or more storeys.
proposed.explanation: This replaces overbroad corridor-wall wording with the checked protected-exit source rule.
